evals.prompt: Build a mobile checkout flow supporting iOS and Android in both portrait and landscape orientations.
evals.expected_output: Enforce 44x44pt (iOS) / 48x48dp (Android) touch targets with 8px spacing, safe area insets, thumb-zone primary CTA in portrait, compact side rail and paired fields in landscape, and tactile touch-down scale.
expectations: Meets minimum 44x44pt iOS and 48x48dp Android hit target sizes
Adapts portrait thumb-zone layout to phone landscape (<450px height)

evals.prompt: Design a tablet split-view reader for iPadOS.
evals.expected_output: Implement a 2-column adaptive layout in tablet portrait (<75ch reading width) and a master-detail dual-pane layout in tablet landscape supporting both touch and pointer hover states.
expectations: Restricts reading column width to 65-75 characters in tablet portrait
Uses master-detail dual-pane architecture in tablet landscape
